Enrich person.name: Erik Molinaro
Enrich person.title: VP, Head of Customer Operations (Kraken Program)
Enrich person.summary:
I am a Senior Operations Executive specializing in business transformation, with 25+ years of experience reimagining customer operations, building new capabilities, and turning around underperforming organizations. My career spans insurance, renewable energy, and now utilities, where I have consistently helped organizations deliver step-change improvements in efficiency, customer experience, and employee engagement.

I thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution — partnering with leadership teams to design the future state of operations, then driving the organizational, cultural, and technological changes needed to bring that vision to life. My approach balances measurable results (efficiency gains, cost reductions, revenue growth) with people outcomes (engagement, inclusion, leadership development).

Career highlights include:

Standing up a new customer service and operations organization at a high-growth solar company, achieving a 60+ NPS, raising employee engagement above 40 eNPS, and improving service levels by 60% despite a 102% increase in volume.

Leading a 150+ person operations team at Liberty Mutual with an annual budget of $13M, reducing headcount by 31% while handling 51% more work, generating $47M in new revenue through redesigned processes, and achieving a 96% employee engagement score following a major reorganization.

Managing global teams and partnerships, including 700+ offshore vendor resources, to deliver consistent results across the U.S., India and Guatemala.

I am most proud of partnering with others to reimagine what’s possible with teams — enabling transformation that is not only operationally effective but also sustainable, customer-focused, and people-centered.

I hold an MBA from Boston University and an MS in Management Information Systems. Outside of work, I enjoy traveling with my family and exploring the outdoors together.

experience.title: Senior Vice President, Customer Experience & Operations
experience.summary:
Nexamp is a market leader in solar and energy storage solutions. I was responsible for the company’s customer experience initiatives and all ongoing customer operations, reporting directly to the CEO. I led a multi-layered organization of 65+ employees, supported by global vendor partners, with accountability across sales, customer service, revenue operations, billing, collections, commercial account management, and utility relationships.

Key Achievements:
•	Scaled operations through hypergrowth: Despite contact volumes increasing 100%+, billing 84%, and sales 157%, our teams consistently exceeded service-level targets while reducing headcount by 19%+.
•	Improved customer experience: Delivered industry-leading post-call CSAT of 8.8/10
•	Drove revenue and efficiency gains: Increased Inside Sales productivity by 207%, while reducing cost per sale. Generated ~$100M in revenue through optimized credit and billing operations.
•	Strengthened collections and compliance: Improved collections performance by over 50%, and maintained 100% compliance with subscription requirements.
•	Enhanced utility and regulatory relationships: Created a new role for utility relationships, resulting in strengthen partnerships with our utility partners and the introduction of the “ideal CS market” model now being used to shape consumer policy.
•	Created a new Transformation Office: Built Nexamp’s first dedicated transformation function, staffing process optimization experts who delivered cross-functional improvements for Clean Energy Deployment (EPC).
•	Supported strategic growth and financing: Partnered with executive leadership and investors, shaping the customer operations narrative that supported more than $2B in new financing.

experience.title: Vice President, Customer Experience & Billing Operations
experience.summary:
This role reports directly to the CFO and is responsible for Nexamp's customer experience initiatives and ongoing billing operations for the community solar initiatives.

The team handles all incoming contacts from customers, delivering an industry leading customer experience - as measured through NPS. In addition, the group is responsible for interactions with our utility partners and the end-to-end billing operations function. This work is inclusive of commercial and residential customers across the entirety of Nexamp's community solar portfolio.

During the first year of my tenure, highlights included:

•	While contact rates increased by over 102%, helped lead the implementation of a number of new processes that improved availability for customers by over 20% and improved service levels by over 60%
•	Launched both Voice of the Customer and Voice of the Employee surveys to track both consumer and employee sentiment
•	Implemented initiatives to drive employee engagement scores above a 40 eNPS
•	Created customer journey maps to understand the end-to-end customer experience and develop plans to improve across several key areas of the journey 
•	Improved customer facing processes leading to NPS scores of 60+ 
•	Assessed the organizational structure and created a strategic roadmap for staffing; created seven new roles within the organization, writing the job descriptions and partnering with the People Team to define compensation for all new roles
•	Built team and individual scorecards to measure performance and track results over time
•	Led the research and selection process to identify a new payment processor for the organization
•	Managed the implementation of a new billing system, including the migration of customer data from the existing system

experience.title: Senior Executive Manager of U.S. Sales Support & Offshore Vendor Quality
experience.summary:
Senior Operations Executive leading a 150+ person team responsible for supporting our U.S. Sales process for both Independent Agents and direct sales, as well as assessing the overall quality of work completed by our off-shore vendor partners in India.  The team takes over 500K calls annually and processes an additional 200K transactions annually, along with providing process improvement and project management expertise.  

With multiple layers of management, the team totals more than 150 direct employees with an operational budget over $13 million annually.  The role reports directly into the SVP of domestic Distribution Operations.

Highlights include:

•	Improved processes internally to reduce headcount by 31.8% over two years while taking on 51% more work. 
•	Reduced expenses by ~$3MM while improving stakeholder satisfaction by 19 points – to a 9.7 out of 10 – and employee satisfaction, as measured through a net promotor score, by 53 points – to a 78 out of 100.
•	Redesigned the work within a team responsible for identifying pricing inefficiencies, improving results by 68% over two years, which generated an additional $47MM for the organization.  
•	In both 2019 and 2020, developed scorecards and implemented process changes that resulted in double-digit productivity improvements.
•	Led all aspects of an organizational redesign that resulted in position eliminations for 30+ employees while simultaneously implementing plans that achieved a 96% overall engagement score in an annual employee survey.
•	Talent process owner for 700+ person Operations organization; designed and implemented a variety of standardized processes to raise overall employee satisfaction.  
•	Developed a new voice of the customer process that generated over 800 pieces of feedback in the first six months, allowing managers to address individual coaching gaps and improve team workflows.

experience.title: Senior Executive Manager of of Customer Support, Quality & Compliance Operations
experience.summary:
Senior Operations Executive leading a team of 100+ individuals located throughout the U.S. responsible for supporting Liberty Mutual's Business Insurance operations.  Owns responsibility for answering over 350K incoming calls from Independent Agents with questions on our digital platform.  Additionally the team developed and executed on our quality assurance programs, enhancing operations compliance and providing support to our Sales and Underwriting organizations.  The team supports well over a million interactions annually across 10,000+ stakeholders, while maintaining high levels of employee engagement.

Areas of focus include:
1. Managing the Quality Assurance program for all work completed by offshore vendor partners and onshore contact centers.

2. Delivering technical support to Independent Agents, Consumers and internal Underwriting employees.  

3. Developing overall risk framework for Business Insurance and coordinating activities with independent auditors. 

In 2018:
1.  Redesigned offshore quality program by bringing it back onshore, reducing expense by ~$2.5MM while improving overall process quality.

2.  Completed organizational redesign to reduce annual operational expenses by $600K and increasing team productivity by 318%.

experience.title: Senior Product Owner of Contact Center Technology
experience.summary:
Senior Operations Executive leading an Agile transformation team with a $36.5 million annual budget.  Directing a team of Product Owners responsible for managing several key aspects of integrating contact center technologies impacting over 25 million contacts annually.  Leading the team through an Agile development process within the following key areas.

1.	Contact Center Technology (Telephony, IVR, etc.)
2.	Advanced Analytical desktop tools
3.	Independent Agent portal (Safeco Now) and Employee portal
4.    Agent and Employee Knowledge Management & Contextual Help
5.	Underwriting decision tools
6.	Task Management tools

The Product Owners and Agile squads total approximately 150 individuals.  The key responsibilities of the team include developing the long-term road map for the domains identified above. The team partners with business stakeholder to build out product backlogs and directs the Agile teams delivering functionality to improve identified KPIs supporting Liberty Mutual's domestic Distribution organization.

In addition, the group is responsible for ensuring that all new processes are aligned with Liberty Mutual's overall customer experience strategy.
